ITEM 1 | Whole apple, red blush over yellow-green skin with a smooth, slightly glossy surface, stem cavity visible at top, roughly 8 cm diameter and about 7 cm tall, sitting on the left-center of the plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Whole roasted-looking almonds, tan-brown skins with ridged, slightly rough texture, dry and firm, scattered in a loose heap across the upper-right of the plate covering roughly a quarter of the plate, each nut about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, piled a few layers deep | 40
ITEM 3 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red with smooth taut skins, whole and intact, about 3 cm in diameter each, nine pieces arranged in a loose arc across the center and right of the plate, juicy-looking with slight sheen | 135
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white to ivory with slightly bumpy, granular surface, firm and raw-looking, no browning or char, cut into bite-sized florets about 3 to 4 cm across, clustered in a band along the bottom-right of the plate next to the apple and tomatoes | 130
